comments.body:
Use **repository secrets for API keys**. Use **repository variables / workflow `env` only for non-secret configuration** like `AGENT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, `AGENT_RUNS_ON`, or policy JSON.

Concretely for `OPENAI_API_KEY`: yes, Sepo should wire it into agent runs by default when Codex is selected, but it should be treated as a provider credential, not as general prompt context. The current repo already follows that model:

- Quick start says to add `OPENAI_API_KEY` as a repo secret: [README.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/README.md#L17-L18)
- Config docs classify it under repository secrets, not variables: [.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md#L34-L40)
- Provider resolution uses the secret to detect Codex in `auto` mode: [.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.sh](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.sh#L39-L75)
- The task runner maps the action input into `OPENAI_API_KEY` only for the subprocess that runs the agent/provider: [.agent/src/run.ts](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/run.ts#L254-L262)

The “chain of variables” is a little annoying, but it is the right GitHub Actions shape:

```yaml
secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY
  -> reusable workflow secret
  -> composite action input
  -> INPUT_OPENAI_API_KEY
  -> OPENAI_API_KEY for the provider process
```

That indirection is better than storing the key in repo variables because GitHub masks secrets in logs, controls when secrets are available, and keeps secret values out of normal workflow/config surfaces.

The important boundary I’d keep is: **do not pass arbitrary repository secrets to the agent by default**. Only pass the small fixed set Sepo needs to operate, such as provider credentials and GitHub auth. If a repository wants the agent to use application-specific secrets, that should be an explicit opt-in per workflow/action, ideally scoped to that route or task.

title: Should we do environment variable or repo secrets?
